part.text:
Project set up. Layout:

- `package.json` — ESM package, `npm test` via `node --test`, CLI bin `range-to-regex`
- `src/range-to-regex.js` — `rangeToRegex(min, max)` → source string, `rangeToRegExp(min, max)` → anchored `RegExp`
- `bin/range-to-regex.js` — CLI: `range-to-regex 1-100`
- `test/range-to-regex.test.js` — 8 tests, all passing

Usage:

```
node bin/range-to-regex.js 1-100
# ([1-9]|(1[0-9]|[2-8][0-9]|9[0-9])|100)
```

```js
import { rangeToRegExp } from './src/range-to-regex.js';
rangeToRegExp(1, 100).test('42'); // true
```

It handles multi-length ranges, rejects leading zeros, validates bounds, and spans up to `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`.
